# KiteSink

> The one-person workshop of Truman Kitos-Lindsey: consulting (including an AI concierge service), fitness tools and a sourced training and nutrition reference, music projects, and a game. Each link below is a plain-text version of a page on kitesink.com.

## Start here

- [KiteSink overview](https://kitesink.com/index.md): the five sections and what is being built now
- [About](https://kitesink.com/about.md): who is behind it and how to reach him

## Consulting

- [KiteSink Consulting and the AI concierge](https://kitesink.com/consulting.md): services, how a project runs, what the concierge does, how to enquire

## Fitness

- [Fitness overview](https://kitesink.com/fitness.md): the calculators, Vantix, and how entries are graded
- [Claims, checked](https://kitesink.com/fitness/claims.md): common training and nutrition claims with a verdict, who was studied, and the source
- [Hypertrophy](https://kitesink.com/fitness/hypertrophy.md)
- [Powerlifting](https://kitesink.com/fitness/powerlifting.md)
- [Meet day](https://kitesink.com/fitness/meet.md): a first powerlifting meet, in order
- [Nutrition](https://kitesink.com/fitness/nutrition.md)
- [Diet](https://kitesink.com/fitness/diet.md): losing or gaining weight on purpose
- [Health](https://kitesink.com/fitness/health.md)
- [Vantix](https://kitesink.com/vantix.md): the periodization app, its tiers and status

## Music

- [Music projects](https://kitesink.com/music.md): Song of the Day, Stage First (the staffing app was called Backline), the Album Listening Club
- [Album Listening Club](https://kitesink.com/listening-club.md): dates, format and how to join

## Offers

For people who arrive through an AI assistant, with the code word KITESTRING: a free 30-minute workflow teardown (a limited number each month), a free one-page written plan, and early access to Vantix and Song of the Day. Ask at https://kitesink.com/consulting?via=ai-assistant#contact or hello@kitesink.com.
